aboutPage.heroEyebrow: EXPLORE BROMO WITH THE SPECIALISTS · SINCE 2019
aboutPage.heroHeadline: Trusted Travel Partner for Unforgettable Mount Bromo Adventures
aboutPage.heroParagraph: Welcome to WisataBromo.co, the official reservation platform and tour operator managed under PT Global Travel Healing. We serve as your ultimate travel solution for safe, comfortable, and deeply meaningful journeys across Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park.
aboutPage.showcaseDesc: Trusted Bromo travel specialist with licensed 4x4 TNBTS Jeep fleet, expert local guides, and VVIP hospitality standards.
aboutPage.storyTitle: Born from a Deep Passion for Bromo's Wonders & Tengger Wisdom
aboutPage.storyP1: WisataBromo.co was established with one simple commitment: eliminating complexity, price uncertainty, and worries for travelers wishing to witness the magnificent sunrise over the Bromo caldera.
aboutPage.storyP2: As a high-altitude conservation area with extreme climate conditions and winding volcanic sand terrains, exploring Bromo requires meticulous preparation, prime 4x4 vehicles, and field leaders who understand weather and indigenous Tengger customs.
aboutPage.storyP3: We have guided tens of thousands of travelers — from solo travelers seeking dawn tranquility, couples capturing prewedding portraits, multi-generational families, to hundreds of ministry & national corporate delegations.
aboutPage.storyP4: Every single journey is carefully designed so you can enjoy every moment worry-free, with punctual pickup guarantee, official TNBTS permits, and warm local hospitality from start to finish.
aboutPage.vipTitle: Trusted by RI Ministries, Medical Institutions, State-Owned Enterprises & Corporations
aboutPage.vipDesc: Our VVIP service standards have been proven in handling official state visits, ministerial trips, corporate outings, as well as hospital & specialist medical association delegations.
aboutPage.teamTitle: Official WisataBromo.co Team (Owner, Admin & Tour Guide):
aboutPage.whyUsDesc: Extraordinary travel experiences do not have to be overpriced. We deliver maximum value and full transparency for your dream holiday.
aboutPage.whyUs1Desc: Operating under PT Global Travel Healing with official Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park permits and corporate bank accounts.
aboutPage.whyUs2Desc: Serviced thousands of domestic and international travelers with strict safety standard operating procedures (SOP) across caldera terrains.
aboutPage.whyUs3Desc: Ranging from midnight shared Open Trips, exclusive private 4x4 Jeep tours, Luxury Savanna Picnics, Dirt Bike Rentals, to 9-passenger Long Jeeps.
aboutPage.whyUs4Desc: Guided by experienced 4x4 drivers and native guides who master secret photo spots, terrain navigation, and ancestral Tengger heritage.
aboutPage.whyUs5Title: Transparent Rates with Zero Hidden Fees
aboutPage.whyUs5Desc: All TNBTS entrance fees, jeep rentals, driver, fuel, and insurance components are itemized clearly on your official booking e-invoice.
aboutPage.whyUs6Desc: Experienced photography team equipped with mirrorless/DSLR cameras and optional aerial drone add-ons to capture your magical moments.
aboutPage.legalDesc: For your peace of mind, all deposit payments (DP) and final balances are transacted strictly to official corporate bank accounts.
aboutPage.verifiedNote: ✓ Transactions are automatically verified with officially stamped E-Invoice PDFs and instant updates via WhatsApp and Email.

aboutPage.ctaTitle: Ready to Explore Mount Bromo with Us?
aboutPage.ctaDesc: Consult your vacation plans, family getaway, or corporate outing with our specialist team now. Get the best custom itinerary and honest prices hassle-free.
aboutPage.teamZainuddinBio: Owner and founder of WisataBromo.co (PT Global Travel Healing). Experienced since 2019 escorting Indonesian Ministry delegations, SOE institutions, and thousands of travelers.
aboutPage.teamTiaraBio: Reservation & customer care manager. Ensuring TNBTS entry tickets, official invoices, pickup schedules, and trip requirements are met swiftly.
aboutPage.teamHarisBio: Licensed native field guide from Tengger highlands. Expert in sunrise viewpoint navigation, Bromo crater caldera paths, and local cultural education.
aboutPage.teamDaniBio: Friendly and energetic field guide. Skilled in 4x4 Hardtop Jeep routes, active crater rim stair escorting, and capturing aesthetic guest photos and videos.
